page.layout: One block of verse: a single column of italic lines running down the page, stanzas separated by spacing. Printed page number at the top right corner.

main_text.p:
Illi nam duplici confuta pallia
Panno, & crassa domum penula protegit.
Illi perpetuis ignibus atria
Propellunt hyemes lucida frigidas.

Illi puniceo purpura murice
Ardet tincta:micat Sestibus illitum
Aurum coccineis, atque tapetibus
Claros nobilibus condecorat thoros.

Illi interproceres conspicuos sedet
Coniux purpurea splendidor toga:
Quum lites remouent Abramidum, & simul
Portis turba frequens conuenit Srbium.

Quantas perpetuis cogit opes lucris,
Quum telas Tyriis syndonibus pares,
Et quae pinxit acu mollia nobili
Diuendit pretiis carbasa grandibus.

Hinc mentem trepidis intrepidam gerit
Rebus:non dubij temporis exitum,
Casusve ancipites, aut pauet anxia
Quae Sventura dies durior apparat.

Illi Serba fluunt pectore candido
Sempermellifluis picta leporibus:
Et puram loquitur quae sapientiam
Spirent, quaeque nitens gratia temperet.

Ædes mane suas sollicitis Sigil
Lustrat luminibus, singula dispicit,
Vt se quisque gerat, sordibus & procul

page.notes: Verse page; the text is set in italic. Some words are doubtful: "tincta", "Srbium", "Sventura" and "Sestibus" are read with uncertainty, and the initial letters of some lines appear to be swash capitals. The line-end at "Sigil" and "procul" may run on. No catchword or signature visible.
